citations.quote: Name: Karma. Official role tags: Mage, Support.
Active: Karma fires a bolt in the target direction that explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies and briefly slowing them.
Active: Karma applies a shield on herself or the target allied champion for a short time, which briefly grants bonus movement speed.

core_mechanics.summary: Karma is a mage/support with magic-damage poke, slows, shielding and movement-speed support.

citations.quote: Karma empowers her next ability to do an additional effect.
Karma's damaging abilities will reduce the cooldown of Mantra.

core_mechanics.summary: Mantra empowers her next ability, and damaging abilities help bring Mantra back.

cards.purpose: Recognize a poke and protection mage whose empowerment choice changes the threat. Her supplied kit describes movement-speed boosts but no dash or blink; account for speed-assisted repositioning.
cards.title: Karma: poke, protection and empowerment

citations.quote: Mantra can be used while affected by cast-inhibiting crowd control.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Mantra itself can be activated during cast-inhibiting crowd control; this does not establish that the subsequent basic ability can be cast during it.

citations.quote: Active: Karma empowers her next basic ability within 8 seconds for an additional effect.

core_mechanics.summary: Mantra empowers the next basic ability rather than directly attacking an enemy.

citations.quote: Mantra is available at level 1 and does not require a skill point.
Karma begins the game with one rank in Mantra. Her empowered abilities scale based on Mantra's rank.

core_mechanics.summary: Mantra is available at level 1 without spending a skill point; empowered abilities scale with Mantra's rank.

citations.quote: Innate: Mantra's current cooldown is reduced by a few seconds for each enemy champion hit by Karma's damaging abilities.

core_mechanics.summary: Gathering Fire reduces Mantra's current cooldown when Karma's damaging abilities hit enemy champions.

cards.purpose: Expect empowerment from the opening levels and recognize that successful champion damage accelerates its return.
cards.title: Mantra and Gathering Fire

citations.quote: Active: Karma fires a bolt in the target direction that explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies and briefly slowing them.

core_mechanics.summary: Inner Flame is a directional bolt that explodes on the first enemy hit, damaging nearby enemies with magic damage and briefly slowing them.

cards.purpose: Recognize the poke projectile and avoid its splash even when another unit intercepts it.
cards.title: Inner Flame: explosive slowing bolt

citations.quote: Spell shield will block the initial impact from either ability but will not block Soulflare's field damage.

advanced_exceptions.summary: A spell shield can block the initial impact while leaving the field damage unblocked.

citations.quote: Mantra Bonus: Inner Flame deals increased damage, and fires a larger bolt that also explodes at max range. The explosion briefly creates a field that slows enemies, which then ruptures to deal magic damage.

core_mechanics.summary: Soulflare increases Inner Flame's damage and bolt size, and allows the bolt to explode at maximum range.

citations.quote: The explosion briefly creates a field that slows enemies, which then ruptures to deal magic damage.

core_mechanics.summary: The explosion leaves a slowing field that later ruptures for magic damage.

cards.purpose: Recognize empowered Q and leave the lingering field before its delayed damage.
cards.title: Soulflare: empowered blast and delayed field

citations.quote: Active: Karma deals magic damage to the target enemy champion, monster or pet and forms a tether between her and them for 2 seconds, during which they are revealed.

core_mechanics.summary: Focused Resolve targets an enemy champion, monster or pet, dealing magic damage and forming a revealing tether.

citations.quote: If the tether is not broken by the end of its duration, the target is dealt the same magic damage again and is rooted for a duration, during which they are revealed.

core_mechanics.summary: An unbroken tether ends with further magic damage and a root that continues revealing the target.

cards.purpose: Recognize the tether as a delayed root threat and prioritize breaking it before completion.
cards.title: Focused Resolve: tether into root

citations.quote: Spell shield will block the tether's application and damage but not the aftereffects of one already applied.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Spell shielding does not stop the aftereffects of an already applied tether.

citations.quote: On cast, Renewal is treated as 2 abilities for Conqueror and Electrocute, instead of 1.(bug)

advanced_exceptions.summary: The packet marks special rune counting as a bug; it is excluded from established mechanics.

citations.quote: Focused Resolve's root is increased. Karma heals herself once on-cast, and again once the target is bound or dies while tethered.

Mantra Bonus: Focused Resolve's root duration is increased. Karma heals for 17% (+ 1% per 100 AP) of her missing health once on-cast, and again once the tether lasts its full duration or the target dies while tethered.

core_mechanics.summary: Renewal heals Karma based on missing health at cast, then heals her again if the tether completes or its target dies while tethered.

cards.purpose: Anticipate a low-health Karma's healing reversal and the longer root; breaking the tether can prevent its completion-triggered heal.
cards.title: Renewal: self-healing tether

citations.quote: Active: Karma applies a shield on herself or the target allied champion for a short time, which briefly grants bonus movement speed.

core_mechanics.summary: Inspire briefly shields Karma or a targeted allied champion and grants bonus movement speed.

cards.purpose: Recognize protection and speed that can help a target escape, approach or maintain a tether.
cards.title: Inspire: shield and movement speed

citations.quote: Inspire's shield is increased, and Inspire spreads to surrounding allied champions at reduced power.
Mantra - Active: Inspire grants a bonus amount of shielding.Inspire spreads to surrounding allied champions, granting them a shield for 2.5 seconds and 15% bonus movement speed for 2 seconds.

core_mechanics.summary: Defiance strengthens the primary shield and spreads reduced-power shielding and movement speed to surrounding allied champions.

cards.purpose: Recognize group protection and acceleration that can enable a coordinated approach or retreat.
cards.title: Defiance: group shielding and speed

conflicts.resolution: Use qualitative damage effects. The appended change note is not treated as a current damage table.
conflicts.topic: Soulflare damage arrays coexist with a different appended primary-damage change note.

conflicts.resolution: Teach champion-hit cooldown reduction qualitatively from the dedicated live section and Riot description; omit exact reduction values.
conflicts.topic: Gathering Fire's live description is mixed with an uncontextualized historical cooldown-reduction change line in wiki:P.

factual_risks: The packet does not establish a current patch label; pinned Data Dragon numbering must not be converted into one.
The absence of a dash or blink is an inference from the complete supplied active kit, not an explicit quoted mobility restriction.
Renewal bug and unexpected-interaction notes are not established current mechanics; visual tether bugs, cast-cancellation bugs and rune interactions are excluded from core requirements.
Lore, skins and collection text embedded in wiki:R do not describe combat mechanics.
Exact damage, shielding, healing, cooldown and duration arrays are unnecessary for these recognition goals and may contain stale notes.
This inventory is unapproved editorial material.

section_disposition.reason: Passive cooldown recovery belongs with the empowerment cycle rather than a separate recognition card.
Projectile collision, splash and slowing define the base poke threat.
The delayed field creates a distinct avoidance goal; spell-shield behavior remains advanced and numerical change notes are excluded.
Recognizing and breaking the tether is a distinct response to the delayed root.
Self-healing and the extended root change enemy commitment decisions; bug notes remain outside core learning.
Targeted shielding and speed have a distinct defensive and repositioning purpose.
Group shielding and acceleration are recognizably different from the targeted base cast.
The system card explains empowerment selection, early availability and rank dependence together with passive recovery.

summary: A concise overview, a combined Mantra/passive system card, and distinct base-ability and empowered-variant recognition goals. Emphasis is on magic poke, tether counterplay, healing reversals and targeted versus group protection.
